answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 39423 Country: KW Title: What is the name of the angel of death (Malak al-Maut) Question: What is the name of the angel of death (Malak al-Maut). Is it anywhere mentioned as Izrail? Answer ID: 39423 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1029/1029/M=1433) Yes, the name of angel of death (Malak al-Maut). Yes, he is called Izrail (علیہ السلام). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
